Hero_Desc_Kidian:
A willing outsider among the dragons. An obsidian dragon.
She's so used to being alone that she is excessively shy.
The way she considers herself worthless evokes sympathy from the people around her.
Album_Kidian1: Kidian is understood to be an outsider among the dragons. She is an obsidian dragon, preferring to be alone, and who dislikes the light.
Album_Kidian2: Although she appears to be quiet and is cautious of those around her, surprisingly, she has a laid-back side to her. She doesn't care who's around her, so long as they don't pose a threat.
Album_Kidian3: The small cuts on her body are from handling the obsidian she collects. They say obsidian becomes incredibly sharp when broken... Perhaps a metaphor for her own personality?
Album_Kidian4: Kidian has a rather apathetic relationship with the other dragons. Unlike the other dragons who love getting dolled up, Kidian shows little interest in such things. This difference in thinking may be why they don't seem very close...
Album_Kidian5: Although Kidian claims she doesn't particularly feel lonely, her expression changes when dealing with the other races. She seems to think being around those without preconceived notions or prejudices is more comfortable.
Album_Kidian6: Kidian is afraid of going to the surface where the sky is visible. Even if the light dazzles your eyes, she's sad she won't be able to shine, no matter how bright that light may be.
Album_Kidian7: I spent an entire day convincing Kidian to step outside. At first, she looked awkward and uncomfortable, but she gradually adapted. Realizing that what she had feared wasn't such a big deal, she could only let out a sheepish smile. That day, her dark horns and hair shone brighter than usual under the sunlight.

Venturing out?
It might be okay if we're together...

I should
return to my cave.

LoveLetter_Kidian: I was over being friends with anyone after my fight with Daya. I guess I was scared about being lonely again after getting into another argument.So when you reached out to me first, I was really shocked. I wasn't sure if I was capable of making friends again, either. But you kept coming back to me and putting in the effort. Now, I want to put in the effort, too.Can I call you my friend?
LoveCall_Kidian:
The more I learn about you, the more I realize what a wonderful friend you are, Master. Sometimes it makes me feel strange.

You are always kind and gentle with everyone, so unlike me, you have many friends around you.
When I see you surrounded by the Apostles... something feels strange inside.
I want to stand in the place closest beside you, but at the same time, I am afraid that perhaps you do not consider me that close.

But... even so, I am glad I became your friend.
I liked that you spoke to me and approached me first... Yes...
You are... the most precious person in the world to me.
Am I the most precious person to you too?
